Dear Madam
I see I made a mistake in addressing your letter, as you have left Windsor. I therefore write again to give my full permission for the translation of the [Questions on the Gospels](../books.html#105)[^1]

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: This translation has not been identified.
